## 8fb5ddcd0504

**Reproduced defect: advertised non-singleton overrides are ignored.** On generator SHA `1ce1a702f2e7cf186fdc5f56675002fb12f12ac2bf829df4eeba2c37dc514adb`, seed 17, sample index 9, medium difficulty, distinct legal values for `palette_kind`, `palette_size`, `n_distinct_colors`, and `texture` all produced byte-identical 5×7 grids. Each returned grid passed the target's `self_check`, so this is not merely rejection or a malformed-input artifact. The complete source-bound reproducer, cases, grids, and override values are in `checks/audit/8fb5ddcd0504/ignored-overrides.json`.

The generator advertises these axes as controls, but the observed output always contains one nonzero color and does not vary with the requested palette or texture settings. This undermines controllability and can overstate dataset diversity. The optional audit task-test stage found no task-local or selected frozen tests (exit 5), recorded in `checks/audit/8fb5ddcd0504-task-tests/result.json`. I left the audit target unchanged.
